summary_1line: Sages recount how devotion to Mahadeva and recitation of his hymn granted them purification, boons, knowledge, power, or liberation.

image_candidates.scene_text: The sage Gritsamada, cursed by Vasistha, transforms into a sorrowful deer wandering a desolate forest before praying to Maheswara.
Mandavya, impaled yet serene, prays to Shiva as the bull-riding deity appears and grants him freedom and long life.
Krishna performs severe austerities on the mountains of Meru, reciting the thousand names of Mahadeva beneath the vast sky.
